verses.original: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם נָ֣א אִיּ֣וֹב שְׁמַֽע־ מִלָּ֑י הַאֲזִֽינָה׃ וְֽכָל־ דְּבָרַ֥י
verses.transliteration: wə·’ū·lām nā ’î·yō·wḇ šə·ma‘- mil·lāy ha·’ă·zî·nāh wə·ḵāl də·ḇā·ray
verses.literal: But now O Job hear my speech and listen to all my words

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ נָ֭א פָּתַ֣חְתִּי פִ֑י דִּבְּרָ֖ה בְחִכִּֽי׃ לְשׁוֹנִ֣י
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- nā pā·ṯaḥ·tî p̄î dib·bə·rāh ḇə·ḥik·kî lə·šō·w·nî
verses.literal: Behold . . . I will open my mouth my address is on the tip of my tongue

verses.original: אֲמָרָ֑י יֹֽשֶׁר־ לִבִּ֥י שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י מִלֵּֽלוּ׃ בָּר֥וּר וְדַ֥עַת
verses.transliteration: ’ă·mā·rāy yō·šer- lib·bî śə·p̲ā·t̲ai mil·lê·lū bā·rūr wə·ḏa·‘aṯ
verses.literal: My words are from an upright heart and my lips speak sincerely what I know

verses.original: רֽוּחַ־ אֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֑תְנִי וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּחַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: rū·aḥ- ’êl ‘ā·śā·ṯə·nî wə·niš·maṯ šad·day tə·ḥay·yê·nî
verses.literal: The Spirit of God has made me and the breath of the Almighty gives me life

verses.original: הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי אִם־ תּוּכַ֥ל עֶרְכָ֥ה לְ֝פָנַ֗י הִתְיַצָּֽבָה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·šî·ḇê·nî ’im- tū·ḵal ‘er·ḵāh lə·p̄ā·nay hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣā·ḇāh
verses.literal: Refute me if you can prepare your case and confront me . . .

verses.original: הֵן־ אֲנִ֣י כְפִ֣יךָ לָאֵ֑ל אָֽנִי׃ גַם־ קֹרַ֥צְתִּי מֵ֝חֹ֗מֶר
verses.transliteration: hên- ’ă·nî ḵə·p̄î·ḵā lā·’êl ’ā·nî ḡam- qō·raṣ·tî mê·ḥō·mer
verses.literal: - I . . . am just like you before God I was also formed from clay

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה לֹ֣א אֵ֭מָתִי תְבַעֲתֶ֑ךָּ לֹא־ וְ֝אַכְפִּ֗י יִכְבָּֽד׃ עָלֶ֥יךָ
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh lō ’ê·mā·ṯî ṯə·ḇa·‘ă·ṯe·kā lō- wə·’aḵ·pî yiḵ·bāḏ ‘ā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Surely no fear of me should terrify you nor will my hand be heavy upon you

verses.original: אַ֭ךְ אָמַ֣רְתָּ בְאָזְנָ֑י וְק֖וֹל אֶשְׁמָֽע׃ מִלִּ֣ין
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ’ā·mar·tā ḇə·’ā·zə·nāy wə·qō·wl ’eš·mā‘ mil·lîn
verses.literal: Surely you have spoken in my hearing . . . and I have heard these very words

verses.original: אֲנִ֗י זַ֥ךְ בְּֽלִ֫י פָ֥שַׁע אָנֹכִ֑י חַ֥ף וְלֹ֖א עָוֺ֣ן לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî zaḵ bə·lî p̄ā·ša‘ ’ā·nō·ḵî ḥap̄ wə·lō ‘ā·wōn lî
verses.literal: I am pure without transgression I am clean with no iniquity in me

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יִמְצָ֑א תְּ֭נוּאוֹת עָלַ֣י יַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לֽוֹ׃ לְאוֹיֵ֣ב
verses.transliteration: hên yim·ṣā tə·nū·’ō·wṯ ‘ā·lay yaḥ·šə·ḇê·nî lōw lə·’ō·w·yêḇ
verses.literal: Yet [God] finds occasions against me He counts me as His enemy

verses.original: יָשֵׂ֣ם רַגְלָ֑י בַּסַּ֣ד יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כָּל־ אָרְחֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yā·śêm raḡ·lāy bas·saḏ yiš·mōr kāl- ’ā·rə·ḥō·ṯāy
verses.literal: He puts my feet in the stocks He watches over all my paths

verses.original: הֶן־ לֹא־ צָדַ֣קְתָּ זֹ֣את אֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ יִרְבֶּ֥ה מֵאֱנֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: hen- lō- ṣā·ḏaq·tā zōṯ ’e·‘ĕ·ne·kā kî- ’ĕ·lō·w·ha yir·beh mê·’ĕ·nō·wōš
verses.literal: Behold you are not right in this matter I will answer you for God is greater than man

verses.original: מַ֭דּוּעַ רִיב֑וֹתָ אֵלָ֣יו כִּ֥י יַעֲנֶֽה׃ לֹ֣א־ כָל־ דְּ֝בָרָ֗יו
verses.transliteration: mad·dū·a‘ rî·ḇō·w·ṯā ’ê·lāw kî ya·‘ă·neh lō- ḵāl də·ḇā·rāw
verses.literal: Why do you complain to Him that He answers nothing . . . a man asks

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֵ֑ל יְדַבֶּר־ בְאַחַ֥ת וּ֝בִשְׁתַּ֗יִם לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’êl yə·ḏab·ber- ḇə·’a·ḥaṯ ū·ḇiš·ta·yim lō yə·šū·ren·nāh
verses.literal: For God speaks in one [way] and in another [yet] no one notices

verses.original: בַּחֲל֤וֹם׀ חֶזְי֬וֹן לַ֗יְלָה תַּ֭רְדֵּמָה בִּנְפֹ֣ל עַל־ אֲנָשִׁ֑ים בִּ֝תְנוּמ֗וֹת עֲלֵ֣י מִשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥă·lō·wm ḥez·yō·wn lay·lāh tar·dê·māh bin·p̄ōl ‘al- ’ă·nā·šîm biṯ·nū·mō·wṯ ‘ă·lê miš·kāḇ
verses.literal: In a dream in a vision in the night when deep sleep falls upon men as they slumber on their beds

verses.original: אָ֣ז יִ֭גְלֶה אֹ֣זֶן אֲנָשִׁ֑ים יַחְתֹּֽם׃ וּבְמֹ֖סָרָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: ’āz yiḡ·leh ’ō·zen ’ă·nā·šîm yaḥ·tōm ū·ḇə·mō·sā·rām
verses.literal: - He opens their ears . . . and terrifies them with warnings

verses.original: לְ֭הָסִיר אָדָ֣ם מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה יְכַסֶּֽה׃ מִגֶּ֣בֶר וְגֵוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: lə·hā·sîr ’ā·ḏām ma·‘ă·śeh yə·ḵas·seh mig·ge·ḇer wə·ḡê·wāh
verses.literal: to turn a man from wrongdoing and keep him from pride

verses.original: יַחְשֹׂ֣ךְ נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־ שָׁ֑חַת וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ מֵעֲבֹ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁלַח׃
verses.transliteration: yaḥ·śōḵ nap̄·šōw min·nî- šā·ḥaṯ wə·ḥay·yā·ṯōw mê·‘ă·ḇōr baš·šā·laḥ
verses.literal: to preserve his soul from the Pit and his life from perishing by the sword

verses.original: וְהוּכַ֣ח עַל־ מִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ בְּ֭מַכְאוֹב אֵתָֽן׃ וְרִיב עֲצָמָ֣יו
verses.transliteration: wə·hū·ḵaḥ ‘al- miš·kā·ḇōw bə·maḵ·’ō·wḇ ’ê·ṯān wə·rīḇ ‘ă·ṣā·māw
verses.literal: A man is also chastened on his bed with pain and constant distress in his bones

verses.original: חַיָּת֣וֹ וְזִֽהֲמַ֣תּוּ לָ֑חֶם וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ תַּאֲוָֽה׃ מַאֲכַ֥ל
verses.transliteration: ḥay·yā·ṯōw wə·zi·hă·mat·tū lā·ḥem wə·nap̄·šōw ta·’ă·wāh ma·’ă·ḵal
verses.literal: so that he detests his bread and his soul [loathes] his favorite food

verses.original: בְּשָׂר֣וֹ יִ֣כֶל מֵרֹ֑אִי לֹ֣א רֻאּֽוּ׃ עַ֝צְמוֹתָ֗יו וּשְׁפִי
verses.transliteration: bə·śā·rōw yi·ḵel mê·rō·’î lō ru’·’ū ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯāw ū·šə·p̄ī
verses.literal: His flesh wastes away from sight and his hidden . . . bones protrude

verses.original: נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וַתִּקְרַ֣ב לַשַּׁ֣חַת וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ לַֽמְמִתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šōw wat·tiq·raḇ laš·ša·ḥaṯ wə·ḥay·yā·ṯōw lam·mi·ṯîm
verses.literal: He draws near to the Pit and his life to the messengers of death

verses.original: אִם־ יֵ֤שׁ מַלְאָ֗ךְ עָלָ֨יו׀ אֶחָ֥ד מֵלִ֗יץ מִנִּי־ אָ֑לֶף לְהַגִּ֖יד לְאָדָ֣ם יָשְׁרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yêš mal·’āḵ ‘ā·lāw ’e·ḥāḏ mê·lîṣ min·nî- ’ā·lep̄ lə·hag·gîḏ lə·’ā·ḏām yā·šə·rōw
verses.literal: Yet if there is a messenger on his side one mediator in a thousand to tell a man what is right for him

verses.original: וַיְחֻנֶּ֗נּוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פְּ֭דָעֵהוּ מֵרֶ֥דֶת שָׁ֗חַת מָצָ֥אתִי כֹֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥun·nen·nū way·yō·mer pə·ḏā·‘ê·hū mê·re·ḏeṯ šā·ḥaṯ mā·ṣā·ṯî ḵō·p̄er
verses.literal: to be gracious to him and say Spare him from going down to the Pit I have found his ransom

verses.original: בְּשָׂר֣וֹ רֻֽטֲפַ֣שׁ מִנֹּ֑עַר יָ֝שׁ֗וּב לִימֵ֥י עֲלוּמָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: bə·śā·rōw ru·ṭă·p̄aš min·nō·‘ar yā·šūḇ lî·mê ‘ă·lū·māw
verses.literal: then his flesh is refreshed like a child’s he returns to the days of his youth

verses.original: יֶעְתַּ֤ר אֶל־ אֱל֨וֹהַּ׀ וַיִּרְצֵ֗הוּ וַיַּ֣רְא פָּ֭נָיו בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה וַיָּ֥שֶׁב צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃ לֶ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ
verses.transliteration: ye‘·tar ’el- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah way·yir·ṣê·hū way·yar pā·nāw biṯ·rū·‘āh way·yā·šeḇ ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw le·’ĕ·nō·wōš
verses.literal: He prays to God and finds favor he sees [God’s] face and shouts for joy and God restores His righteousness to that man

verses.original: יָשֹׁ֤ר׀ עַל־ אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר חָ֭טָאתִי הֶעֱוֵ֗יתִי וְיָשָׁ֥ר וְלֹא־ שָׁ֥וָה לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yā·šōr ‘al- ’ă·nā·šîm way·yō·mer ḥā·ṭā·ṯî he·‘ĕ·wê·ṯî wə·yā·šār wə·lō- šā·wāh lî
verses.literal: Then he sings before men with these words I have sinned and perverted what was right yet I did not get what I deserved

verses.original: פָּדָ֣ה נַפְשִׁי מֵעֲבֹ֣ר בַּשָּׁ֑חַת וְחַיָּתִי תִּרְאֶֽה׃ בָּא֥וֹר
verses.transliteration: pā·ḏāh nap̄·šī mê·‘ă·ḇōr baš·šā·ḥaṯ wə·ḥay·yå̄·ṯī tir·’eh bā·’ō·wr
verses.literal: He redeemed my soul from going down to the Pit and I will live to see the light

verses.original: הֶן־ כָּל־ אֵ֭לֶּה אֵ֑ל יִפְעַל־ עִם־ גָּֽבֶר׃ פַּעֲמַ֖יִם שָׁל֣וֹשׁ
verses.transliteration: hen- kāl- ’êl·leh ’êl yip̄·‘al- ‘im- gā·ḇer pa·‘ă·ma·yim šā·lō·wōš
verses.literal: Behold all these things God does to a man two or even three times

verses.original: לְהָשִׁ֣יב נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־ שָׁ֑חַת לֵ֝א֗וֹר בְּא֣וֹר הַֽחַיִּים׃
verses.transliteration: lə·hā·šîḇ nap̄·šōw min·nî- šā·ḥaṯ lê·’ō·wr bə·’ō·wr ha·ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: to bring back his soul from the Pit that he may be enlightened with the light of life

verses.original: הַקְשֵׁ֖ב אִיּ֥וֹב שְֽׁמַֽע־ לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וְאָנֹכִ֥י אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: haq·šêḇ ’î·yō·wḇ šə·ma‘- lî ha·ḥă·rêš wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: Pay attention Job and listen to me be silent and I will speak

verses.original: אִם־ יֵשׁ־ מִלִּ֥ין הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי דַּ֝בֵּ֗ר כִּֽי־ חָפַ֥צְתִּי צַדְּקֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yêš- mil·lîn hă·šî·ḇê·nî dab·bêr kî- ḥā·p̄aṣ·tî ṣad·də·qe·kā
verses.literal: But if you have something to say answer me speak up for I would like to vindicate you

verses.original: אִם־ אַ֭יִן אַתָּ֥ה שְֽׁמַֽע־ לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ֥ חָכְמָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’a·yin ’at·tāh šə·ma‘- lî ha·ḥă·rêš wa·’ă·’al·lep̄·ḵā ḥāḵ·māh
verses.literal: But if not . . . then listen to me be quiet and I will teach you wisdom
